purpose: Isolate whether explicit paired prompt-discrimination supervision can make the fixed prompt_mean_vector scorer learnable without changing the feature cache, teacher, split, projection dimensions, FPGA query shape, or token budget contract.

frozen_inputs.split: reuse existing source_image_sha256 grouped split; train=318 records/159 images, val=76 records/38 images

student.fpga_query_contract: one 1x128 query per prompt; 128 bytes at INT8 before scale/alignment overhead
student.note: Keep full-rank Wt/Wv in this feasibility stage so the only causal variable is paired supervision. Low-rank compression is a later stage only if this gate passes.

arms.name: A_KL_ONLY_CONTROL
arms.purpose: Control for retraining the non-collapsing reducer without explicit paired discrimination.

arms.name: B_KL_PLUS_ADAPTIVE_SWAP_HINGE

definitions.margin: JS_nats(y_g,y_p), computed from train-pair teacher_soft only

arms.reason: All terms are in nats. Weak/ambiguous teacher pairs receive a small margin; strongly distinct pairs receive a larger margin. No manually tuned loss weight or fixed margin is introduced.

optimization.model_selection: validation objective only; save epoch 0 and every completed epoch

validation_statistics.independent_unit: image; average grounding/pointing record deltas before resampling
validation_statistics.holm_family: 2 arms x 2 controls x 2 primary metrics = 8 tests
validation_statistics.seed_aggregation: take the per-image median delta across the three seeds before bootstrap/permutation; also require the delta sign to be positive in at least 2 of 3 seeds

promotion_gate.A_prompt_sensitivity: For same-image-other-task, both primary deltas >0, 95% CI lower >0, |dz|>=0.2, Holm-adjusted p<0.05, and positive sign in >=2/3 seeds.
promotion_gate.B_shuffled_discrimination: For cross-image-same-task derangement, both primary deltas >0, 95% CI lower >0, |dz|>=0.2, Holm-adjusted p<0.05, and positive sign in >=2/3 seeds.
promotion_gate.D_teacher_alignment: Median-seed val correct Spearman and NDCG-full each >= frozen hard_max baseline minus 0.01 (0.0564749736 and 0.8499415696).
promotion_gate.E_generalization: At least 2/3 seeds select an epoch >0 and improve the val training objective relative to epoch 0.
promotion_gate.F_hardware_contract: Runtime query remains 1x128 and FPGA scorer remains Gx128 dot; no token-axis max/softmax/exp is introduced.
promotion_gate.winner_rule: Only arm B may be promoted as the proposed method, and only if B passes A-F. Arm A is an ablation/control, not a fallback winner. Otherwise result is NO_PROMOTION.

after_gate.if_pass: Freeze the paired-supervision protocol, then start a separate low-rank/quantization and spatial-anchor fixed-budget stage. Do not evaluate the existing internal test split in this feasibility stage.
after_gate.if_fail: Stop projection-scorer retraining and redesign the teacher/supervision. Do not add post-hoc margins, reducers, ranks, or extra epochs.
after_gate.formal_evaluation: Use an independently frozen external benchmark protocol later; the existing internal test has already been observed in prior diagnostics and is not a pristine final holdout.
